summary: Existing office accounts can now be used as admins, and PIM Manager never changes an account it did not create.

new.title: Use existing office accounts as admins
new.text: The importer, adopt and the Create admin wizard now fully support existing office accounts, synced from AD or cloud-only. PIM Manager never changes an account it did not create.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The hybrid worker never touches existing office accounts, and the database statistics share now rounds to a whole number.
